provenance.note: Full, deterministically-generated import of the real web client's own per-locale image-existence digests, replacing the earlier 10-entry hand-authored seed (see git history for that file). This is authoritative, pinned source data, not hand-curated: tools/generate_asset_locale_digest.py parses each locale's raw file below independently, validates every path against the exact category-root/extension shapes this client models, and rejects anything else outright (an unmapped root that is not explicitly listed in ignoredCategoryRoots, a malformed path, or a duplicate) rather than silently dropping or reinterpreting it. Korean (ko) is intentionally empty: the upstream source itself ships zero entries for that locale, not a data-collection gap.
provenance.sourceFileNote: Each entry below is a raw JSON array of asset-relative paths (e.g. "cards/01001b.avif"), copied byte-for-byte from frontend/src/digests/<locale>.json at sourceCommit -- these are the exact files the real client's checkImageExists()/isLocalized() consult (see frontend/src/arkham/helpers.ts's digestLoaders map). No official image binaries are included anywhere in this repository: these files are plain lists of path strings.

localeMapSource: djensenius/ArkhamHorror-Linux#17 issue body: 'Preserve the web locale mapping it -> ita, fr -> fr, es -> es, ko -> ko, zh -> zh.'
ignoredCategoryRootsNote: Any path root NOT present in acceptedCategoryRoots and NOT listed here is a hard generator error, so a future upstream addition of localized art for a category this client does not yet model (e.g. portraits) cannot be silently dropped -- it must be a conscious code change.

ignoredCategoryRoots.tarot: Tarot-card art (frontend/src/digests/fr.json's 22 "tarot/tarot-N.jpg" entries) is not a modeled AssetCategory in this client (see AssetTypes.h); explicitly and deliberately excluded rather than silently dropped.
